prompts: Create an eight-frame CARRYING WALK animation sprite sheet using the attached original characters. 4 columns x 2 rows, transparent background. Row1 Aria, Row2 Leon. Match EXACT reference identities, proportions, head size relative to legs, clothing, warm illustrated rendering and elevated 3/4 screen-right view. Both gloved hands stay fixed supporting an INVISIBLE crate at waist height in EVERY frame, palms up and separated, forearms forward. No props drawn. The LEGS MUST ALTERNATE, not repeat one leg: col1 NEAR foreground leg strides FORWARD to screen-right, far leg back left; col2 near leg is vertical WEIGHT-BEARING under hip, far knee swings forward close beside it with boot clearly off ground; col3 FAR leg strides FORWARD right and NEAR leg trails BACK left, clear reverse of col1; col4 far leg vertical weight-bearing under hip and near knee swings forward with boot off ground. Short natural careful carrying steps, not running or kicking. Same body size, head location, shoulder height, torso length, boots and hand positions across columns, mild knee flexion only. Do not make each frame taller or shorter. Keep clear space between boots so support leg vs raised foot is legible. All full figures with generous transparent gutters, no shadows/floor/text/grid. Preserve Aria lavender lock opposite white flower, pointed ears green eyes green cape cream blouse leather boots. Preserve Leon side-swept brown hair, red short cape blue tunic small shoulder armor. Four distinct phases of ONE cycle per row.

Correct ONLY the leg animation in columns 3 and 4 of this 4-column 2-row transparent sprite sheet. KEEP columns1 and2, all upper bodies, hands and heads unchanged. CRITICAL problem: column3 currently repeats column1 and column4 repeats column2. Need OPPOSITE leg phases. In column3 of BOTH rows: the leg whose hip is on the LEFT side of the picture must cross IN FRONT of the other thigh diagonally to the RIGHT, and its boot must be the RIGHTMOST forward boot. The leg whose hip is on the RIGHT side of the picture goes diagonally BACK LEFT behind the other leg, with heel raised. Thus near thigh/boot visibly occludes far thigh; trace each thigh from hip to correct boot, avoid disconnected/crosswired legs. Aria's bare thigh without leather strap is the forward foreground leg in column3; her strapped thigh goes back behind it. In column4 of BOTH rows: that LEFT-hip foreground leg swings forward, knee bent, boot lifted OFF ground in front; the RIGHT-hip far leg is straight vertical support with boot ON ground. All figures still face right, do NOT horizontally mirror character identity or upper body. Keep identical heights, head sizes, same warm rendering, no added floor or props, transparent background. The goal is alternating anatomical legs, not changing face or cape.
